name: shared-service-classes
goal: Services lists shared instantiated classes with multiple instance methods and canonical PascalCase names, excluding functions, objects and static namespaces

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The 57c67724 catalog admits 13 non-class exports among 81 entries. Spec requires concrete constructed classes, multiple public instance methods and distinct runtime owners.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The standard metadata owner matrix and responsive current/history card scenario accepted a workflow as a service. Extended reusable declaration, construction, method and eligibility fixtures; test titles preserved.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed 9d64d930; immutable red e1e62a2606afed01c2c12d93e19339d01b9e23d95919c8fc55fb6ebc4812002e. Source class proof assertion fails; class-only browser count captures the workflow defect before assertion.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Record concrete class facts and constructor references from the existing AST parser; resolve inherited methods; require matching source proof, construction, multiple instance methods and per-class owners in the catalog. Emit the same rule in existing guidance.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Added owner-local source class proof, default/factory constructor tracking, inherited public methods, per-class consumers and catalog eligibility. Normal metadata/catalog suites, type checks and Reports lint pass; registry refreshed to 1309 units and 63 explicit uncertain references.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
